messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning a small dev-focused launch: hands-on refapp + mini-benchmark narrative + workshop. Objective = dev signups + qualified leads. want to keep it developer-first and practical.
sam: i'm up for the tutorial repo + quickstart steps. prefer a three-step lab: local run -> profile -> deploy to hosted.
maya: perfect. target publish date: 2026-04-14. milestones: tutorial draft 4/1, benchmark writeup 4/3, landing + routing 4/6, webinar slides 4/9, dry-run 4/10.
ton y: i'll pull perf runs and annotate the config we used. will include median/p95 and a small table of cost/token.
elena: i'll do the landing + copy. want two CTAs on the page: "Try the refapp" and "Register for workshop". also need the form + routing spec for inbound.
kai: visuals ok. i'll create a hero gif showing local->hosted flow and two chart templates (p95 vs tokens, cost per 1k tokens).
sam: tutorial outline: 1) clone + install (docker option), 2) run sample script to reproduce baseline numbers, 3) swap config for optimized path (batching, kv cache), 4) deploy to Hosted via API key. keep each step 5-8 mins.
elena: routing plan proposal: Form (Typeform) fields: name, email, company, role, use-case, traffic estimate, interest: Dedicated? yes/no, opt-in marketing. Flow: Typeform -> Zapier -> HubSpot -> create contact + tag (refapp-workshop, benchmark-interest) -> assign to SDR team. also post a message to #inbound-leads.
ops-bot: Zapier -> HubSpot webhook validated at 2026-03-27T10:02:00Z.
ton y: benchmark narrative: keep it realistic. show baseline (no cache, single stream), tuned (batch 8, cache on, quant q4), and discuss tradeoffs. micro-case: "3.2x lower cost per token on 4k workload with caching + quant". include config snippet (high-level).
kai: can you give me the exact numbers, tony? i need to mock the charts.
ton y: baseline p95 420ms, tuned p95 120ms, cost per 1k tokens baseline $1.80 -> tuned $0.55. i'll upload CSV to drive.
sam: include a runnable bench command in the tutorial, e.g.:```bash
./run_bench.sh --model redwood/llama-13b-q4 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --cache off --out baseline.csv
./run_bench.sh --model redwood/llama-13b-q4 --seq 4096 --batch 8 --cache on --quant q4 --out tuned.csv
```
elena: landing page fields done. i'll add hidden fields for campaign_id and ref. also set up a Zap filter for Dedicated inquiries to CC the enterprise team.
maya: webinar format: 45m total: 20m demo + 15m hands-on lab walkthrough + 10m live Q&A. host will do short intros and CTAs.
ton y: panel = me + sam + elena. i'll prepare a short script for the demo steps and the key slides on perf.
kai: i'll draft visuals by EOD tomorrow. want one explainer card about "what the refapp does" and 2 slides showing perf improvements.
sam: repo plan: keep the code snippets minimal, add a prebuilt container. i'll add a LICENSE (MIT) and a short CONTRIBUTING.md.
maya: messaging notes: avoid absolute claims like "x times faster" without context. always state test rig, model, seq len, and cache settings.
elena: for registration routing, i'll create the Typeform and share the link in this thread. expect to test end-to-end on 4/5.
ops-bot: scheduled reminder set: dry-run on 2026-04-10 09:00 UTC.
maya: good. recap owners: sam=tutorial + repo, tony=bench numbers + narrative, kai=visuals + hero gif, elena=landing + routing + copy, maya=launch post + webinar host + project ops.
maya: i'll drop the calendar invite and a shared drive link in 10. ping here once drafts are ready. :rocket:
